moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-data-story-queue-compress, written here): 4 slots (50 x 44, 64 px pitch). Item 01: progress bar fills 400-1100 ms easeInOut, turns green at 1100; exits 1300-1600 ms ease-in cubic, y -40 px + fade. Then items 02-04 each shift one slot left on a spring (stiffness 240, damping 24), starting 1650 + 60 i ms; counter n = 4 -> 3 at 1600 ms. Order matters: the exit finishes before the shift starts. Params: process (0.7 s) · exit (0.3 s) · spring (240 / 24) · stagger (60 ms). Order matters: the finished card has left before the others move up.
